name: StepDice
description: Tempo-synced step FX dice for NTS-3. A bar is split into 16, 8, 4, 2, or 1 steps and each step draws a different effect (gate, filter, crush, ring, pan, drive, stutter, reverse, echo). X = intensity, Y = pattern seed. Default HOLD engages only while touching; RUN stays always on and tap re-rolls.

params.name: AMT
params.detail: How hard each step effect hits

params.name: DICE
params.detail: Pattern seed: move to scramble which effect lands on which step

params.name: BANK
params.detail: Effect palette: ALL, FLT, GLCH, TONE

params.name: DENS
params.detail: How many steps are wet versus left dry

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: HOLD = engage only while touching (default). RUN = always on, tap to re-roll
